alate: Head capsule of the dealate adult blackish brown, compound eyes purplish brown, pronotum yellow, postmentum nearly yellow, femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow. Head capsule circular, vertex slightly flat, fontanelle in the middle of the head. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 5%, long diameter slightly greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, long diameter equal to the ocellus–compound eye distance. Postclypeus projecting, about level with the ocelli and lower than the vertex. Antennae 18–19 segments. Anterior margin of the pronotum wavy and incised in the middle, posterior margin double-waved and also incised in the middle.
soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles dark brown, antennae and pronotum cream-yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.62–0.65, lateral margins slightly wavy, the posterior half slightly enlarged, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Labrum broadly ligulate, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles stout, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.53–0.55 times head capsule length and 0.83–0.85 times head width. Antennae 17–18 segments. A dot-like projection in the middle of the broad anterior region of the postmentum, waist constriction index 0.37. Anterior margin of the pronotum straight with a V-shaped notch in the middle, lateral margins gradually narrowing posteriorly, posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs; setae in the middle region abundant and dense.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
